findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_products, get_data_dictionary · Private data: register_agent, topup_credits, list_datasets, fetch_dataset · Public sink: topup_credits · Destructive: get_derivation_ledger.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_products, get_data_dictionary · Private data: register_agent, topup_credits, list_datasets, fetch_dataset · Public sink: topup_credits · Destructive: get_derivation_ledger

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "register_agent" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
